changes: Derive current lineage and unique action route from authenticated Ready and TX evidence; keep original registry inputs and explicit route choices pinned.
Reject unknown outer/sibling actions; retain unmatched nested same-target invocations without turning them into claimed historical actions.
Synchronize the Morpho child JSON, root registration, shared conversion exclusion, and three fixtures from cloud json-all; regenerate target artifacts.
Require active behavior probes for declared conversion actions; eliminate duplicate preview IDs and retain exact input debit checks.
Use a top-level Silo identity probe for its independently verified actor; leave executor-frame authority checks unchanged.

interruption.reason: Stop this task factual batch after confirmed nested-callback false rejection; retain all partial evidence before a corrected full rerun.

deterministicFlips.defect: Silo actor declared as an executor call frame
deterministicFlips.result: Ready/Graph, exact, quoted and runtime pass; both output deltas zero; no-input and rollback controls pass

deterministicFlips.defect: Nested same-target callback rejects an otherwise matched Fluid action
deterministicFlips.result: Same-state acceptance pass; original TX evidence-incomplete remains unchanged

independentReview.identityAndMorpho: Non-author read-only review confirmed Silo caller mode, active action proofs, and preview-request uniqueness. No transport authority relaxation.
independentReview.nestedActionBinding: Fresh non-author review confirmed Fluid/V4 nested-call false rejections; approved only strict same-target descendants. V1 exact-output and ERC4626 repayWithShares remain unsupported-action controls.

limitations: Same-state historical-node simulation, not intra-block reproduction of the original transaction.
Original TX input/action conflicts remain reference evidence and are not rewritten as matched.
Morpho and all other family-wide completeness claims remain limited to the registered cases and known action inventory; remaining genuine adaptation failures were not hidden.
No live run, broadcast, deployment, whole-universe Ready rebuild, or production performance acceptance was performed.
